text:
elaine: Quick: we need a lightweight ops pack for launch posts — KW shortlist, JSON-LD for webinar + benchmark pages, an internal-link map (seed -> clusters), and redirect rules for old blog slugs. Can we freeze copy + ops by EOD Fri?
marco: I can do KW shortlist + anchor CSV. thinking 12 prioritized queries: feature perf, latency benchmarks, integration how-tos, cost comparisons. will surface intent labels (TOF/MOF/BOF).
jamal: Will craft two small JSON-LD blocks: Event and Article. Paste these in head and validate. Minimal Event example: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-14T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}
```
sophia: I exported legacy slugs (/blog/* pre-2024) to the Redirects sheet. Proposal: 302 for 10 days for testing + analytics, then 301 after we confirm canonical mappings. Infra window request: 02:00-04:00 UTC.
elaine: add an "anchor_rewrite" column mapping CTAs to primary (/webinar) and fallback (/demo-request). Top-funnel posts should keep a single CTA.
seo-bot: crawl-scan: benchmark-drafts => flagged 5 images without alt, 3 internal links 404. See sheet rows.
marco: I'll fix missing alts and broken anchors. Internal-link mapping (seed launch overview) -> clusters: benchmark, integration guide, pricing comparison, migration guide, customer case study. Anchor text examples: "benchmark results", "integrate with X", "cost vs performance", "migration steps", "customer story". Limit to 2 contextual links per cluster.
elaine: marco, drop CSV with columns: source_url, target_url, anchor_text, reason into the shared drive.
marco: will do. ETA 3pm PT :thumbsup:
jamal: QA note: include Article.mainEntityOfPage and image object to Article JSON-LD for better rich snippets. Run Rich Results Test + Lighthouse. I can run a smoke pass after deployment.
sophia: sample nginx rules for infra (in sheet comments): ```nginx
# temp 302 for test window
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 redirect;
# promote to 301 after QA window
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 permanent;
```
elaine: final checklist by EOD Fri:
- marco: KW shortlist + anchor CSV uploaded
- jamal: schema snippets + validation notes
- sophia: redirect sheet + infra ticket + rollout window
- elaine: copy QA + CTA placement (one primary CTA on TOF posts)
marco: ack
sophia: ack, pinging infra for slot
jamal: ack, will queue validation when schema is live
elaine: one small ask: keep promotional messaging concise and funnel to the webinar signup. Post-launch we'll iterate CTA language based on benchmark traffic and engagement. :rocket:
